description: Search the Police Grant Register's DOJ COPS award lists by fiscal year (FY2020 to the latest published, default latest), program, state and recipient name. Amounts are DOJ's announced awards, not outlays; the lists do not record scoring, so an award must never be attributed to a recipient's immigration posture. DOJ's Estimated Award Amount columns are labelled estimated. The FY2024 technology rows are held because that list does not reconcile; DOJ's printed total is identified as its figure only. JAG formula allocations, COPS awards and forfeiture payments are never added together. Reviewed DOJ-list and ICE 287(g) matches are labelled as such; forfeiture payments appear only side by side.

fy.description: Fiscal year of DOJ announced award lists, from 2020 to the latest published; defaults to latest.

program.description: Optional program code from the published program list.

recipient.description: Optional case-insensitive recipient name substring, at most 80 characters.

state.description: Optional two-letter recipient state or territory code.

name: police_grant_awards
title: Find DOJ Police Grant Awards
